definitions.explanation: Indicates that the displayed price includes consumption tax. The standard phrase seen on price tags and menus.

examples.japanese: {税込|ぜいこみ}{百円|ひゃくえん}です。
⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{税込|ぜいこみ}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧です。
{税込|ぜいこみ}{価格|かかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: It's easy to understand because prices are shown including tax.

notes:
{税込|ぜいこみ} indicates that a price includes consumption tax (⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧). You'll see this constantly on price tags, menus, and receipts in Japan.

FORMS:
⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧ (tax) + ⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ (included). The ⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ pattern appears in other words like {送料込|そうりょうこ}み (shipping included).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税込|ぜいこみ}{価格|かかく}: tax-inclusive price
- {税込|ぜいこみ}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧: tax-inclusive price display
- {税込|ぜいこみ}○○⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: ○○ yen including tax

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {税込|ぜいこみ}: tax included (what you actually pay)
- ⟦{税抜|ぜいぬき}→税抜：09560_zeinuki⟧: tax not included (base price before tax)
- ⟦{本体|ほんたい}→本体：13033_hontai⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: base price (same as ⟦{税抜|ぜいぬき}→税抜：09560_zeinuki⟧)

Since 2021, Japan requires {税込|ぜいこみ} price display (⟦{総額|そうがく}{表示|ひょうじ}→総額表示：24007_sougakuhyouji⟧) in stores.
